title: Image page blocks
description: Allowed block types for an image (gallery) page. Like a component page, an image page is a free-composition block array: the builder seeds it with a single `image_gallery` block (add-page-sheet.tsx INITIAL_BLOCKS) and the user may add/remove any other block, so it validates the same way as component-page.json — the allowed `type` enum plus per-block `data` dispatch via ../block-item.json. (The previous cover_page/main_page-only, max-2-block model matched neither the v2 builder nor the backend's own seed_page_templates image template, which both emit page_title/image_gallery/description_box — QCG-19801.)
